summary: Write and collaborate on Seafile documents directly in a browser with the SeaDoc extension.
overview: SeaDoc adds a collaborative document editor to Seafile. It works with Seafile's document storage and permissions, and its Docker deployment includes a separate document service connected to Seafile. The official seadoc-editor repository contains the editor components used by SeaDoc and Seafile's wiki editing. The Apache-2.0 license linked here covers that editor source; it does not establish the licensing of every component in the separately distributed server image.
